facts.value: Please note the general language requirements mentioned here, as well as the specific language requirements of each partner university in the various country categories.
The information regarding the TOEFL test refers to the internet-based test.

If you do not speak the country's official language, it is recommended, if possible, to acquire basic knowledge of the respective language, especially in Latin America and China. However, this is not a requirement for application!
If multiple language requirements are listed (e.g., TOEFL/IELTS), these should be understood as alternatives, meaning you only need to submit one language certificate.
